compute_tapnet_loss: compute the TAPNet loss combining Huber position loss, occlusion loss, and uncertainty loss
calculate_huber_loss: calculate Huber loss for point trajectory tracking with configurable delta threshold
convert_heatmaps_to_points: convert softmax heatmaps to tracked points using soft argmax with query point constraints
generate_default_resolutions: generate logarithmically-spaced resolution levels for multi-scale refinement
postprocess_occlusions: postprocess occlusion and expected distance logits into boolean visibility flags
